comparison.objective: Prime and route a hose to siphon a stock tank; candidate tunes and locks an impact damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable-hose submersion, pinching, transport, and bimanual endpoint control versus rigid tool insertion and rotary mechanical calibration.
comparison.success_condition: Siphon established while intake remains positioned versus two repeatable safe stops with bounded travel and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Different material regime, manipulation, and outcome. Record specs and flow, spill, drainage, and hose-retention thresholds are missing.
